title: 03 · RADAR & Dojo
description: RADAR lifecycle, coverage and healthy runtime samples, followed by Dojo replay outcomes.

list.name: reference
list.label: Run / monitor reference
list.description: Case-insensitive literal substring in the original record. Applies to every panel, including Dojo.

options.content:
**Lifecycle events describe transitions, not current state.** Use the application's Monitoring view for desired runs, readiness, anomaly evidence and input ownership. The reference filter accepts a run or monitor ID.

Health summaries are emitted about once per minute **only while healthy**. Their absence can mean no monitors, degradation or missing logs. Dojo is offline replay; its outcomes are grouped separately below.

panels.title: Live detection · observed events in the selected range
Runtime starts
panels.description: Runtime-start records, including restored runs. Not the number of currently running monitors.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({stack=~`${stack:regex}`,node=~`${node:regex}`,service=~`radar|${stack:regex}_mqtt-radar`} | json search_message="message" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | label_format line_matches=`{{ if or (eq "${reference:percentencode}" "") (contains (lower (urldecode "${reference:percentencode}")) (lower (__line__))) (contains (lower (urldecode "${reference:percentencode}")) (lower .search_message)) }}yes{{ end }}` | line_matches="yes" | drop line_matches, search_message |= "event=" | json msg="message" | __error__="" | msg=~`(?s)^event=(radar[.]runtime_started)( .*|$)` | drop msg [$__range])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({stack=~`${stack:regex}`,node=~`${node:regex}`,service=~`radar|radar-preflight|${stack:regex}_(mqtt-radar|tactic)`} | json search_message="message" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | label_format line_matches=`{{ if or (eq "${reference:percentencode}" "") (contains (lower (urldecode "${reference:percentencode}")) (lower (__line__))) (contains (lower (urldecode "${reference:percentencode}")) (lower .search_message)) }}yes{{ end }}` | line_matches="yes" | drop line_matches, search_message [$__range])))

panels.title: Runtime samples · expand for healthy detector measurements
Reported processing throughput
panels.description: Last healthy summary in a rolling 2m window, per monitor. Processing rate is measured by the runtime; absent/degraded monitors remain gaps. Shows up to ten highest values at each step.

targets.expr: topk(10, last_over_time({stack=~`${stack:regex}`,node=~`${node:regex}`,service=~`radar|${stack:regex}_mqtt-radar`} | json search_message="message" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | label_format line_matches=`{{ if or (eq "${reference:percentencode}" "") (contains (lower (urldecode "${reference:percentencode}")) (lower (__line__))) (contains (lower (urldecode "${reference:percentencode}")) (lower .search_message)) }}yes{{ end }}` | line_matches="yes" | drop line_matches, search_message |= "event=" | json msg="message" | __error__="" | msg=~`(?s)^event=(radar[.]health_summary)( .*|$)` | json monitor="extra.service_id" | __error__="" | monitor!="" | line_format `{{.msg}}` | logfmt throughput | __error__="" | drop msg | unwrap throughput | __error__="" [2m]) by (monitor))

panels.title: Detector process memory
panels.description: Last healthy process RSS sample in MiB over 2m, per monitor. This is process memory, not worker or container memory utilization. Shows up to ten highest values at each step.

targets.expr: topk(10, last_over_time({stack=~`${stack:regex}`,node=~`${node:regex}`,service=~`radar|${stack:regex}_mqtt-radar`} | json search_message="message" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | label_format line_matches=`{{ if or (eq "${reference:percentencode}" "") (contains (lower (urldecode "${reference:percentencode}")) (lower (__line__))) (contains (lower (urldecode "${reference:percentencode}")) (lower .search_message)) }}yes{{ end }}` | line_matches="yes" | drop line_matches, search_message |= "event=" | json msg="message" | __error__="" | msg=~`(?s)^event=(radar[.]health_summary)( .*|$)` | json monitor="extra.service_id" | __error__="" | monitor!="" | line_format `{{.msg}}` | logfmt memory_mb | __error__="" | drop msg | unwrap memory_mb | __error__="" [2m]) by (monitor))

panels.title: Dojo · expand for offline replay outcomes
Replay completions
panels.description: Completion records for replay attempts; not a count of saved datasets.

panels.description: Includes domain failures logged at INFO and unexpected crashes. Retries may produce several outcomes for one run.

panels.title: Replay lifecycle by outcome
panels.description: Dojo events per bucket. Start, requeue and terminal records are not independent jobs.
